//: Runtime-transform project for the bun typia preload (packages/validation/src/bun/preload.ts). The preload routes each loaded file to its own nearest project, searching upward for `tsconfig.test.json` for test sources and `tsconfig.lib.json` for everything else — so a package needs a src-level override for both. Without this file the nearest test config is packages/lmao/tsconfig.test.json, whose package-root walk hashes the Rust crates and generated distribution in addition to the test sources.
